n: Oak National Academy GCSE Data science AI and machine learning unit
t: An eight-lesson Year 10 unit on AI and machine learning for GCSE computing.
steps: Find the unit on the Oak National Academy website.
Open the lesson list and read the eight titles.
Download the slides and worksheets from the teacher view.
Watch the video for the first lesson.
Check that student devices can reach the Oak site.
Use the quizzes to check understanding after each lesson.
